source_claim: Capcom's original Mega Man and Mega Man 2 manuals identify the first game's six selectable Robot Masters and the second game's eight stage bosses; Capcom's Mega Man 3 game page identifies Proto Man's debut, and Capcom News identifies Splash Woman as a Mega Man 9 Robot Master.
notes: The official Capcom Mega Man manual identifies the first game's six bosses as Cut Man, Guts Man, Elec Man, Ice Man, Fire Man, and Bomb Man (https://captown.capcom.com/uploads/game/manual/3/megaman_ja_G.1062072b-3cbf-4848-b7b1-34ac6aa7ce4c.pdf). The official Mega Man 2 manual's stage-select roster identifies Air Man, Bubble Man, Quick Man, Heat Man, Wood Man, Metal Man, Flash Man, and Crash Man (https://captown.capcom.com/uploads/game/manual/5/megaman2_ja_G.f4c2b2ab-455a-4b4a-b946-23d33f481304.pdf); its Japanese OCR renders Crash as Clash, while the roster and English name are the game's Crash Man. Capcom Town's official Mega Man 3 page states Proto Man made his debut in that release (https://captown.capcom.com/en/classic_games/42). Capcom News describes Splash Woman among Mega Man 9's Robot Masters and identifies her as its first female Robot Master (https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/looking-back-on-mega-man-9). Each relation is limited to an exact campaign member directly covered by these official Capcom sources; no unrelated series characters are inferred.
